title: International Criminal Law Prosecution Witness Statistics
descriptions: This dataset contains information on the number of witnesses called by the Prosecution at the International Criminal Court (ICC), International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY), International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR), and the Special Court for Sierra Leone (SCSL) in all initial cases for core international crimes (except those at the ICC that have not yet seen the defendant's first appearance). Retrials are not included.
